records.groupTitle: Resident Long-Term Unemployment (At Least 25 Weeks) (Annual Average)
records.title: Resident Long-Term Unemployment (At Least 25 Weeks) (Annual Average), Annual
records.footnote: 1. Residents refer to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents.  2. Long-term unemployment refers to persons aged fifteen years and over who have been unemployed for 25 weeks or more (approximately 6 months or more).  3. Data for year 2000 are not available as the question on duration of unemployment was not asked in the Census of Population 2000.  4. June data for 1995 and 2005 are from the General Household Surveys 1995 and 2005 conducted by the Singapore Department of Statistics.
